concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native iPhone app screen for Cuekeeper, edge to edge portrait 1170x2532, no hardware frame or surrounding scene. This is a broadcast freelancer's Upcoming home screen. Concept: Call Sheet, next-job-first. Warm ivory background, deep ink text, dark forest-green interactive tint, very subtle warm separators. SF Pro native typography, highly legible realistic 17pt body scale. Signature: the next engagement has a spacious typographic call-time block paired with session time, like a carefully composed production brief; no paper textures or costume graphics.
Include iOS status bar 9:41 and safe areas. Navigation title Upcoming with small Cuekeeper identity and prominent + Add Job control. Date Monday, October 12. Main content: Today, Northside vs. City, Fieldhouse Sports, Commentator, checkmark Booked. Clearly distinguish Call time 17:30 from confirmed session 18:00–20:30 ET; location Remote. A discreet native View job button. Below, Upcoming list: Wed 14 Oct, Courtside Live, Booked, Schedule to come; Fri 16 Oct, Weekend Preview, Tentative, Dates held · Oct 16–17. Small dismissible Needs attention row: 1 job needs a schedule. Bottom native four-tab bar Upcoming selected, Jobs, Payments, Settings, with coherent SF Symbols-like icons and home indicator. No earnings widgets, charts, photos, countdowns or invented functionality. Finished premium app screen with exceptionally aligned typography and generous but useful spacing. Content must remain readable and fit.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native iPhone app screen for Cuekeeper, edge to edge portrait 1170x2532, no hardware frame or surrounding scene. This is a broadcast freelancer's Upcoming home screen. Concept: Daybook, agenda-first. Clean near-white background, navy ink typography, saturated restrained blue interactive tint and a faint blue-gray date grouping ground. SF Pro native typography, highly legible realistic 17pt body scale. Signature: a clear narrow date gutter with weekday and large day numerals aligns to compact engagement rows; generous separation between days rather than a stack of cards.
Include iOS status bar 9:41 and safe areas. Navigation title Upcoming with small Cuekeeper identity and prominent + Add Job control. Under header October 2026 with a quiet This week / All upcoming segmented control, This week selected. The agenda leads immediately: Mon 12, Northside vs. City, Fieldhouse Sports · Commentator, Booked, then nested confirmed session 18:00–20:30 ET and Call 17:30 · Remote. Wed 14, Courtside Live, Booked, All-day placeholder, Schedule to come. Fri 16, Weekend Preview, Tentative, Dates held · Oct 16–17. Mon 19, Studio Roundup, Booked, All-day placeholder. Clear textual statuses and subtle state symbols. Below a small dismissible Needs attention row: 1 job needs a schedule. Bottom native four-tab bar Upcoming selected, Jobs, Payments, Settings with SF Symbols-like icons and home indicator. No charts, earnings widgets, photos or decorative calendars. Finished premium app screen, dense enough to survey a week while still comfortably readable.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native iPhone app screen for Cuekeeper, edge to edge portrait 1170x2532, no hardware frame or surrounding scene. This is a broadcast freelancer's Upcoming home screen. Concept: Night Shift, compact schedule with today in focus. Refined dark mode for a dim studio: deep charcoal background, slightly lighter grouped surfaces, warm off-white primary text, muted amber for interactive tint. SF Pro native typography, highly legible realistic 17pt body. Signature: vertically aligned tabular time numerals and clean schedule separators inspired by departure-board legibility, without literal flaps, bezels, all-caps clutter or retro texture.
Include iOS status bar 9:41 and safe areas. Navigation title Upcoming with small Cuekeeper identity and prominent + Add Job control. Monday, October 12. A clearly grouped Today area: 17:30 Call time; Northside vs. City, Fieldhouse Sports · Commentator, checkmark Booked; 18:00–20:30 ET confirmed session, Remote, View job. Then Coming up with compact dates and details: Wed 14 Oct, Courtside Live, Booked, Schedule to come; Fri 16 Oct, Weekend Preview, Tentative, Dates held · Oct 16–17; Mon 19 Oct, Studio Roundup, Booked, All-day placeholder. Quiet dismissible Needs attention row: 1 job needs a schedule. Bottom native four-tab bar Upcoming selected, Jobs, Payments, Settings, coherent SF Symbols-like icons and home indicator. Use text as well as symbols for status. No fake live lights, meters, earnings widgets, photos or countdowns. Exceptional alignment and high contrast. A practical native app, not a broadcast control panel.
